what_this_is: The Workshop rows for tools/decide-when-things-show: the person's show rules and the presets they keep, read, changed, switched and shared over their own show-rules record.

payload.label: See when things show
payload.job: Show me the rules that decide when things show, hide or stay quiet for me, and the types I keep
payload.description: Reads your show-rules record and answers every rule in force (the starting rules, your own, and those of the types you have switched on), the subjects a rule can be about with their facts, the moment facts, the effects, the quick choices and the operators a rule's when can use, the types you keep and which are on (in_use). It reads and changes nothing.

space_id.description: A space, when its scoped types should count

now.description: The time to decide at (ISO); now when left out

provenance.source: trillion src/show-rules-store.mjs (190f72754e) read, set and remove, over src/workspace/show-rules.mjs changedRecord (moved here as tools/set-up-my-account/read-data/show-rules.mjs); sharing a kept preset is a2e1365f33's two records

payload.label: Keep a show rule
payload.job: Keep a rule about when something shows, hides or stays quiet for me, or switch a starting rule off or on
payload.description: Keeps one rule in your show-rules record (rule; one with the id of a rule you keep changes it), or switches a starting rule off or on (starting: { id, on }). A rule with a problem is refused in its words. Answers the rules after the change and keep: the record to write, with the record as it was read as expected, so a record changed meanwhile is not written over.

rule.description: A show rule: { id?, label, subject, when, effect, until?, time_zone? } (read the subjects, effects and operators first)

starting.description: { id, on }: a starting rule switched off or back on

now.description: The time to decide at (ISO); now when left out

keep.description: The records to keep, each { label, value, expected? }: written by whoever holds the person's write (the page's records write, or a grant the person gives); this run writes nothing

payload.label: Take a show rule away
payload.job: Take away one of my show rules
payload.description: Takes one rule out of your show-rules record by its id (from see-when-things-show); a starting rule is switched off instead. Answers the rules after the change and keep, the record to write.

now.description: The time to decide at (ISO); now when left out

keep.description: The records to keep, each { label, value, expected? }: written by whoever holds the person's write (the page's records write, or a grant the person gives); this run writes nothing

payload.label: Keep a show type
payload.job: Keep a preset of show rules I can switch on, or change one I keep
payload.description: Keeps one type (a preset: { id, label, inherits?, rules }) in your show-rules record; one with the id of a type you keep changes it. A type inheriting one it does not find, or itself, is refused in its words. Answers keep, the record to write.

type.description: A kept type (a preset): { id, label, inherits?, rules }, id lowercase words joined by hyphens

now.description: The time to decide at (ISO); now when left out

keep.description: The records to keep, each { label, value, expected? }: written by whoever holds the person's write (the page's records write, or a grant the person gives); this run writes nothing

payload.label: Take a show type away
payload.job: Take away a preset of show rules I keep
payload.description: Takes one type you keep out of your show-rules record (remove_type), and switches it off. A type another kept type inherits is refused, since its children would lose rules without saying. Answers keep, the record to write.

remove_type.description: The id of a type you keep

now.description: The time to decide at (ISO); now when left out

payload.label: Switch a kept show type
payload.job: Switch one of my show-rule presets on or off
payload.description: Switches a type you keep on or off (use: { type, on }); only types you keep can be on, and a type applies only while it is on. Started by a wake with no use, it makes every switch your show-type-use records ask for ({ type, on }, in id order), so writing one record switches one type. Answers in_use and keep, the record to write.

now.description: The time to decide at (ISO); now when left out

keep.description: The records to keep, each { label, value, expected? }: written by whoever holds the person's write (the page's records write, or a grant the person gives); this run writes nothing

payload.label: Share a kept show type
payload.job: Share one of my show-rule presets with people so they see Trillion that way
payload.description: Shares a type you keep: answers two records to keep, show-types-shared:<id> = { label, types } (the preset copied whole, with the presets it inherits) and sharing:<that label> = { record, people, changed_at }, which keeps who may read it. people is everyone it is shared with, each { principal, key_blake3 }, the BLAKE3 of the share key you hand them; the key itself is never sent.

type.description: The id of a type you keep

now.description: The time to decide at (ISO); now when left out
